asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates 29 lodges, 18 attractions, tramways, and transportation; needs heavy ongoing property investment.

big_ticket.reason: Attraction tickets, lodge stays, meals and tours are small, per-visit purchases, not large infrequent ones.

cyclical_demand.reason: Tourism, lodging and sightseeing attractions are discretionary travel spending that is easily cut in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual travelers and families; travel trade partners are secondary and mostly small.

notes: Organization buyers (travel trade partners) are a secondary channel; consumers are the main buyers.

offers_products.reason: Retail gift shops and food are incidental to the attractions and lodging experiences.

offers_services.reason: Main offerings are lodging, guided tours, attractions, dining and transportation experiences delivered to guests.

people_delivered.reason: Guests mainly pay for attractions, lodges and vehicles; the assets and locations matter more than staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from seasonal, one-time visitor tickets and lodge stays, not subscriptions or contracts.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Guests, families and kids buy attraction passes, lodge stays, tours and dining directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to travel trade partners such as tour operators and agents, a secondary channel.
